note: Honorific proves a guarded name; a Western name has no romaji route and stays out.
A character name whose other word is plainly Japanese proves the guarded word; a lone one does not.
Short capitals need the titled word somewhere in the book; acronyms and Vietnamese never qualify.
texts: Yui và Aoi đến. Rồi YUI! AOI! HP MP SAO RPG. Sao vậy?
